### MIA IRQ bits

| Bit | Register | Name | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | `IRQ_STATUS_L` | `IRQ_ERROR` | An error was pushed into the error queue. |
| 1 | `IRQ_STATUS_L` | `IRQ_IDXA_WRAPPED` | The active index in window A wrapped and its WRAP_IRQ flag was enabled. |
| 2 | `IRQ_STATUS_L` | `IRQ_IDXB_WRAPPED` | The active index in window B wrapped and its WRAP_IRQ flag was enabled. |
| 3 | `IRQ_STATUS_L` | `IRQ_COMMAND` | Command handler completed; asynchronous commands may raise it again on actual completion. |
| 4 | `IRQ_STATUS_L` | `IRQ_SPEED_CHANGED` | A requested PHI2 speed change was applied. |
| 5 | `IRQ_STATUS_L` | `IRQ_VIDEO_FRAME_REQUEST` | Video client update request accepted. |
| 6 | `IRQ_STATUS_L` | `IRQ_VIDEO_FRAME_SENT` | Initial video response send completed. |
| 7 | `IRQ_STATUS_L` | `IRQ_VIDEO_FRAME_ACKED` | Video client acknowledged the response. |
| 8 | `IRQ_STATUS_H` | `IRQ_INPUT_KEYBOARD` | Enabled keyboard, consumer, or text input event pending. |
| 9 | `IRQ_STATUS_H` | `IRQ_INPUT_MOUSE` | Enabled mouse input event pending. |
| 10 | `IRQ_STATUS_H` | `IRQ_INPUT_GAMEPAD` | Enabled gamepad input event pending. |
| 11 | `IRQ_STATUS_H` | `IRQ_SD_DONE` | An SD/FS command completed successfully. |
| 12 | `IRQ_STATUS_H` | `IRQ_SD_ERROR` | An SD/FS command failed. |
| 13 | `IRQ_STATUS_H` | `IRQ_FS_EVENT` | A filesystem command completed. |
| 14 | `IRQ_STATUS_H` | `IRQ_AUDIO_SEQ_DONE` | A sequenced voice's track finished: it reached END, an unrecognized opcode, or its decode/catch-up budget. |
| 15 | `IRQ_STATUS_H` | `IRQ_TRIGGERED` | Aggregate state maintained by MIA when any masked IRQ flag is pending. |
